rollbackPath: Keep the current asar + afterPack pipeline unchanged; no fuse or artifact change is made by this decision.

If later implemented behind an explicit experiment, gate it as a separate build flavor, keep the stock Electron artifact as the default, and compare launch/app-ready/ready-to-show plus smoke tests before promotion.
A failed experiment can revert the fuse, snapshot files and afterPack mapping without migrating user data; no database or product default is involved.

externalResearch.finding: loadBrowserProcessSpecificV8Snapshot is disabled by default; enabling it requires browser_v8_context_snapshot.bin; when a custom main snapshot is used Electron bootstraps the main Node environment from source, costing part of the embedded snapshot benefit.

Custom snapshots require an mksnapshot binary matching the Electron major version and produce snapshot_blob.bin plus v8_context_snapshot.bin; platform and architecture-specific artifacts are required.

A package can crash with Error loading V8 startup snapshot file if browser_v8_context_snapshot.bin is absent; electron-builder does not synthesize the missing snapshot and the afterPack/resource mapping must be implemented per platform/arch.

estimatedBenefit.upperBoundMs: At most the app-ready/Node heap initialization portion (roughly <= 3.2 s local P50), not the observed full launch; no same-version snapshot build was run, so no percentage is claimed.
estimatedBenefit.whyNotMeasured: Building a custom Electron binary with a matched mksnapshot, browser snapshot fuse, per-arch resources and code signing was not attempted because the decision is to reject unless a later external constraint justifies the build-chain expansion.

abiAndContentRisks: V8 snapshot format is tied to the exact V8/Electron build; version upgrades require regenerated snapshots and a new failure mode.
Only a constrained main-process bootstrap can be snapshotted; user-land modules, native addons, environment-dependent objects and the large runtime/extension graph are not automatically covered.
The snapshot runs before normal error boundaries and configuration loading; a corrupt or stale artifact can fail before the app can show a recovery surface.
Electron custom main snapshot causes Node bootstrap from source, which can reduce the expected benefit.

platformMatrix.risk: Requires browser_v8_context_snapshot.bin in the packaged root; absent file causes fatal startup error. afterPack must copy the artifact before signing.
Separate mksnapshot/arch artifact; current CI matrix and build scripts do not prove it.
Snapshot lives inside Electron Framework.framework Resources with arch-specific filenames; framework signing must include the artifact; current local run cannot prove it.
Separate packaged snapshot path and artifact; not exercised in this Windows-only task.

decisionRationale: 本机 Electron 40.8.4 的实际启动耗时主要发生在 Electron launch 到 app-ready（约 3.1–3.2 s），而自定义 main-process snapshot 只可能影响 V8 heap 初始化，并会让 Electron 从源码 bootstrap Node 环境、抵消部分收益；项目还要求 Windows/macOS/Linux x64/arm64 矩阵、afterPack 平台资源映射与签名前 fuse 翻转，收益未被同版本 before/after 证明。因此不把 V8 snapshot 加入构建链，保留为条件式复核项。
title: 决定是否引入 Electron V8 snapshot
reopenConditions: A same-version Electron A/B demonstrates a repeatable reduction in app-ready or ready-to-show beyond the measured noise.
The build matrix can generate and verify Windows/macOS/Linux x64/arm64 snapshots before signing.
A packaged smoke run proves the stock path and snapshot path both start with no fatal snapshot error.
The benefit survives the documented Node-from-source bootstrap cost and remains worth the added build/signing complexity.

localEvidence.fact: Electron launch to app-ready 3100.8362 ms; app-ready to window 105.014 ms; window to ready-to-show 165.9519 ms; renderer-first-paint 23.8 ms.
Five-run P50: app-ready 3225.9694 ms; window-created 3327.233 ms; ready-to-show 3531.6791 ms; renderer-first-paint 25.1 ms.
Five-run ready-to-show P50 3733.0323 ms and P95 6017.2892 ms; prior startup work already removed serial non-critical initialization.

asar=true, embedded ASAR integrity and onlyLoadAppFromAsar are enabled; afterPack exists; native modules are intentionally not rebuilt. Snapshot wiring would add a new pre-sign build artifact and platform/arch resource mapping.
